SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____ 116E
S. I. C. S. I. P.
No. 94, Special Branch Station,
Date May 19, 1930

CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

Subject Communication dated 4-5-38 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. and Mrs P. Lachminovice.

Made by D. S. I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford D J

Paul LACHMINOVICE, Rumanian of Jewish extraction,
born on July 13, 1876 at Galatz, Rumania. He is reported to have
arrived in Shanghai from Bombay in 1907. From 1910 to 1.27 he
was registered with the local French Consulate-General as a French
protegé. In Shanghai he is generally known under the name L.Paul.
From 1908 to 1910 he was connected with the Mitsui
Bussan Kaisha as an agent for the Dai Nippon Brewery (Tokyo), after
which he was employed as manager of the Dai Nippon Brewery in
Shanghai for about two years. From 1911 to 1918 he conducted his
own business at No 2 Fearon Road under the style " L.Paul & Co.,
Wine & Spirit Merchants" and during the same period was also ma-
nager or proprietor of the New Travellers' Hotel, 1/2 Fearon Road,
for several years. In 1918-1920 he worked as a supervisor at the
Shanghai Cotton Anti-Adulteration Association ( Cotton Testing
House), 1 Kiukiang Road.

In February, 1920 Mrs L.Paul applied for a licence to
keep a restaurant at No. 1044/5 Broadway East. The Police recommen-
ded that the application be refused, as there was every reason to
believe that the place would be, in reality, a drinking saloon of
a type undesirable in that locality.

In January, 1922 the French Police was requested by the
French Consulate-General to furnish information regarding L.Paul
who at that time was employed with Garner, Quelch & Co., Wholesale
Wine & Spirit Merchants. A translation of the report submitted in
this connection reads as follows:-

" L.Paul residing at 46 Ward Road lives with or is
married to a woman who appears to be a Russian and whose acquain-
tance he made at the time when he conducted the Travellers' Bar
in Fearon Road. At present he is engaged in the sale of liquors

机密报告

事由：关于英国总领事馆1938年5月4日来函，涉及P. Lachminovice先生及夫人。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（D. S. I. Prokofiev）撰写。由C. Crawford D J转呈

保罗·拉赫米诺维奇（Paul LACHMINOVICE），犹太裔罗马尼亚人，
1876年7月13日出生于罗马尼亚加拉茨（Galatz）。据报他于1907年
从孟买抵达上海。1910年至1927年间，他在当地法国总领事馆登记
为法国受保护人（French protegé）。在上海，他通常以L. Paul之名
为人所知。1908年至1910年，他与三井物产株式会社（Mitsui
Bussan Kaisha）有联系，担任大日本啤酒株式会社（东京）的代理，
此后他在上海担任大日本啤酒株式会社经理约两年。1911年至1918年，
他在斐伦路（Fearon Road）2号以自己的名义经营“L. Paul & Co.，
酒类商行”，并在同一时期担任斐伦路1/2号新旅客旅馆（New Travellers' Hotel）
的经理或业主数年。1918-1920年，他在九江路1号的上海棉花防掺假协会
（棉花检验所）担任监督员。

1920年2月，L. Paul夫人申请在百老汇路（Broadway East）1044/5号
开设餐馆的执照。警方建议拒绝该申请，因为有充分理由相信，该场所
实际上将成为该地区不受欢迎的那种饮酒沙龙。

1922年1月，法国总领事馆要求法国警方提供有关L. Paul的信息，
当时他受雇于Garner, Quelch & Co.，一家批发酒类商行。就此提交的
报告译文如下：-

“居住在华德路（Ward Road）46号的L. Paul与一名看似俄罗斯籍的女子
同居或已婚，他是在斐伦路经营旅客酒吧（Travellers' Bar）时结识该女子的。
目前他从事酒类销售，

    In July, 1925 Paul called at the S.M.P. Headquarters
and volunteered to give information concerning Dr. Fortunatoff,
a Soviet agent who had fled from Shanghai a few days previously
in order to escape trial on a charge of bribery. From police re-
port dated 25-7-25 submitted in connection with Mr. Paul's visit
it appears that at that time he was employed with Slowe & Co. as
                                        that
a travelling representative and formerly he worked for, amongst
others, Warner, Quelch & Co. and Dent & Co. He first heard of For-
tunatoff in 1921 in Vladivostok and first met him during the lat-
ter part of 1921 at Lichinsky's boarding house, 11 Seward Road,
Shanghai. From that date on he frequently met him at the Jewish
Club, Seward Road, where Fortunatoff used to gamble heavily in
chemin-de-fer. Although Paul described the Jewish club as " a
disgraceful, unsanitary institution and a hot bed of gambling and
Bolshevism" he admitted being a frequent visitor there for seve-
ral years. It is also mentioned in the report in question that
Paul was married to a Jewess who, according to him, was British
by birth.

    Leaving Slowe & Co. in the beginning of 1932 after
about 9 years' service he joined Caldbeck, Macgregor & Co., Ltd
in June of the same year as a salesman at a monthly salary of
$ 300 plus commission. He left this position on 30-9-33 on his
own accord. Since that time he is not known to have been engaged
in any business. It is reported that he possesses certain indepen-
dent means.

    From 1930 he has been residing at House 9 Sun Avenue,
Bubbling Well Road. He occupies a small and very modestly furnish-

    1925年7月，Paul来到工部局警务处总部，自愿提供有关苏联特工
Fortunatoff博士的信息，后者几天前为逃避贿赂指控的审判而逃离上海。
根据1925年7月25日就Paul先生来访提交的警方报告，当时他受雇于
Slowe & Co. 担任旅行推销员，此前他曾为Warner, Quelch & Co. 和
Dent & Co. 等公司工作。他于1921年在海参崴首次听说Fortunatoff，
并于1921年下半年在上海西华德路（Seward Road）11号的Lichinsky寄宿公寓
首次与其会面。从那时起，他经常在西华德路的犹太俱乐部与其会面，
Fortunatoff常在那里大肆进行“谢明德费”（chemin-de-fer，一种纸牌赌博）赌博。
虽然Paul将犹太俱乐部描述为“一个可耻、不卫生的机构，是赌博和布尔什维主义的温床”，
但他承认自己是那里多年的常客。在该报告中还提到，Paul娶了一位犹太女子为妻，
据称她出生时为英国籍。

    在Slowe & Co. 服务约9年后，他于1932年初离职，并于同年6月加入
Caldbeck, Macgregor & Co., Ltd，担任销售员，月薪300元另加佣金。
他于1933年9月30日自愿辞去该职位。自那时以来，未闻其从事任何商业活动。
据报他拥有一定的独立资产。

    自1930年起，他一直居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）孙家弄（Sun Avenue）9号。
他占用该地址的一间小型且家具非常简陋的公寓，并将房屋的其余部分以及
孙家弄11号的二楼转租出去。他支付的租金总额为每月142元。

ed flat at this address and sublets the remaining portion of the
house, as well as the second floor of house 11, Sun Avenue. The
total amount of rent he pays is $ 142 per mensem.

Mr. Paul was one of the founders of the Rumanian As-
sociation in Shanghai in 1930 and was its president until March,
1932. At present he does not participate in the activities of
the Association which, it must be noted, has not the reputation
of a well established organization.

It is reported that some time prior to 1927 Mr. Paul
divorced his first wife (Louise Cornfield?) and subsequently mar-
ried one Ida Cohn, former Russian subject of Jewish origin. At
present she is about 42 years of age.

In 1928 Mr. and Mrs Paul are reported to have visited
Australia where they stayed for about 6 months.

According to Mr. Paul's statement, he now wishes to
proceed to England with a view to settling in the country. He
does not intend to engage in any kind of business there and claims
to be in a position to satisfy the authorities concerned that he
has sufficient funds to maintain himself and his wife. He also
claims to have a guarantee to this effect from one of his friends
in England ( Mr. Kenneth MacDonald, Sighthill Loan, Edinburgh II).

While in Shanghai Mr. and Mrs Paul did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable nature.

                                G. Prokopiev
                                D. S. I.

Paul先生是1930年上海罗马尼亚协会的创始人之一，并担任该协会主席直至1932年3月。
目前他不参与该协会的活动，值得注意的是，该协会并没有一个稳固组织的良好声誉。

据报，Paul先生在1927年之前的某个时候与第一任妻子（Louise Cornfield?）离婚，
随后娶了Ida Cohn，一位前俄国籍犹太裔女子。目前她大约42岁。

1928年，据报Paul夫妇访问了澳大利亚，在那里停留了约6个月。

根据Paul先生的陈述，他现在希望前往英国，打算在该国定居。
他不打算在那里从事任何类型的商业活动，并声称有能力向有关当局证明，
他有足够的资金维持自己和妻子的生活。他还声称获得了他在英国的一位朋友
（爱丁堡II区，Sighthill Loan的Kenneth MacDonald先生）为此提供的担保。

在上海期间，Paul夫妇并未因任何不良性质的活动而引起工部局警方的注意。

                                G. Prokopiev
                                特别调查员（D. S. I.）

SHANGHAI.
4th May, 1938.

Dear Major Bourne,

The Foreign Office has asked for a report
concerning Mr. and Mrs. Lachminovice Paul who reside
at 9, Sun Avenue, Shanghai. The report is required
with particular regard to the financial position of
Mr. and Mrs. Paul, and their intentions as to occupation
should they be permitted enter the United Kingdom.

We should be grateful for any assistance which
you may be able to afford in the matter.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处手写签名难以辨认〕

Major K.M. Bourne, M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Si
